title: Application of the Combinatorial Nullstellensatz to magic-type graph labelings
summary: Let $G=(V,E)$ be a simple graph, and let $k\geq 2$ be an integer. For an edge labeling $h:E(G)\to \mathbb{Z}_{k} \backslash \{0\}$, define the induced vertex label by \[ h^+(v)=\sum_{e \ni v} h(e) \pmod{k}. \] For $t\in \mathbb Z_k$, we say that $G$ is \emph{$t$-sum $\mathbb Z_k$-magic} if there exists such a labeling $h$ satisfying \[ h^+(v)=t \qquad\text{for all }v\in V. \] We say that $G$ is \emph{$\mathbb Z_k$-magic} if $G$ is $t$-sum $\mathbb Z_k$-magic for some $t\in \mathbb Z_k$.
